author: Auditor B
rule: A cell (ticker pattern, time) is REFUSED if its time is in [from, to) of any row with status OPEN or FROZEN. Time = market close_ts (binary), event occurrence where the row says so, candle end_ts or file date (perps, recorders). 'to' null = open ended. A cell in NO row is NOT cleared: the driver also refuses any time at or after forward_default_deny_from unless the signed spec names that window in its holds table. A row with a 'scope' applies only to that kind of data (archive_binary = ENGINE1 binary-market archive and NC15 extracts); a row without 'scope' applies to every kind.
